styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent spring-editorial womenswear detail-page system across the whole set. Layout system: narrow mobile detail column, wide margins, staircased image offsets, one accent rectangle offset behind each lookbook frame, thin rules under every section label, three-step index rows. Icon system: none, except one small flat fruit pictogram used once. Presentation rules: fabric drape, print scale, tier volumes and topstitch relief stay true to the reference; model cropped above the brow so no face identity reads; the garment is always grounded by a contact shadow. No drift: no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented certifications, prices, dates or measurements.

provenance.notes: 源夹为 女装 (4)，与判定 L1 女装一致，无归属冲突。10 片切片中仅首屏有实拍，其余为详情页版式切片（多张图位为空白灰槽），因此模版只提炼版式与视觉语法。已剥离：原始品牌与店铺标识、模特面部身份、上新价与上市日期数字、面料丹尼尔数与成分百分比、尺码表全部实测数值、会员二维码与促销角标、源图原有中英文案（含竖排标题与英文分隔带原文）。所有价格、日期、规格、成分数值均改为 {callout_*} / {selling_point_*} 占位符，不填任何真实数字。注意源图商品信息栏的品名与其拍摄的整套碎花套装自相矛盾（写作另一件 generic 针织上装），故不采信任何源图规格文字，规格屏只保留三档指数的版式结构。花色印花本身属源产品图案资产，模版只保留「印花-留白节奏」这一抽象设计语言，并把逐格复制原印花列为负向项。
